lines: Let's see how they use them.
Bears have the best sense of smell on Earth.
They smell two thousand times better than humans.
They use a large part of their brain to smell.
This helps them to find food from far away.
Cows have a great sense of taste.
They have lots of taste buds on their tongue.
They can know if plants have poison or not.
This helps them to eat safe plants.
Spiders have an amazing sense of touch.
They have tiny hairs on their legs.
The hairs can feel if something moves.
This helps spiders to feel their predators coming.
body.text: Some animals have amazing senses. Let's see how they use them. Bears have the best sense of smell on Earth. They smell two thousand times better than humans. They use a large part of their brain to smell. This helps them to find food from far away. Cows have a great sense of taste. They have lots of taste buds on their tongue. They can know if plants have poison or not. This helps them to eat safe plants. Spiders have an amazing sense of touch. They have tiny hairs on their legs. The hairs can feel if something moves. This helps spiders to feel their predators coming. Then they can run away.
